messages:
eli: Quick FYI 1 opened PR that moves the console observability 'tracing tips' from the old how-to into the new dashboards section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4239
 tasha: Thanks 1. What's changing for the users who copy the SDK snippets? Any breaking param names?
 eli: No breaking changes, but I renamed the param from `traceId` to `tracing.headers.x-trace-id` to match our header-based propagation. Added Node / Python examples.
 miguel: Can you add a micro note about cost: show streaming vs batch token counts? Last month support got questions about why stream looks cheaper for short outputs.
 eli: Good call. I'll add a tiny table and a 1-line cost formula. Also a one-liner KQL query to filter traces by header.
 tasha: Can you paste the KQL snippet here so I can sanity-check it?
 eli: Sure, here's the KQL I plan to include:
 ```kql
traces
| where httpRequest.headers.x-trace-id == "{trace_id}"
| order by timestamp desc
| take 50
```
 miguel: Looks good. Add a note that users should URL-encode the header value when using the dashboard filter widget.
 eli: Will do. Also adding a minimal curl example for folks not using SDKs:
 ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "x-trace-id: req-1234" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"model":"open-runtime/redwood-v2","input":"Ping"}'
```
 qa-bot: CI: link-check found one broken internal link to /console/old-tracing.
 eli: Thanks QA. Replaced link with /console/dashboards/traces and updated redirect note.
 tasha: Can we mention expected latency delta in the snippet notes? e.g. streaming has slightly higher per-request overhead but reduces token billing for interactive flows. Keep it one sentence.
 miguel: Also suggest a recommended roll-out: add the new snippet to the snippet-bundle, keep legacy snippet for 30 days with a deprecation note.
 eli: Added both to PR and included a tiny migration checklist: update route docs, run link-check, update snippet-bundle index.
 docs-bot: CI: spellcheck passed, build docs succeeded 705
 tasha: LGTM from docs side. Miguel, any objections before merge?
 miguel: None from me. Merge when CI green and redirect works.
 eli: Thanks everyone, I'll merge after the redirect is verified and upload a screenshot of the dashboard filter.
